title: Man. Post. Cap. VII: PLAC — head's rebellion pervading nature is imputed
pass_a_gloss: For the rest, the closing words of this comparison—and of the chapter—if rightly understood, Placeus approves: this rebellion of the head that pervaded the whole nature is attributed and imputed to all men.
pass_b_english: For the rest, the extreme words of this comparison of yours, and of the chapter, if they are well understood, I approve: this rebellion of the head by which it pervaded the whole nature is attributed and imputed to all men.
source_text: Caeterum extrema huius tuae comparationis, necnon capitis, si bene intelligantur, verba mihi probantur, haec rebellio capitis qua totam naturam pervasit, tribuitur & imputatur omnibus hominibus.

choices.choice: Head's rebellion pervading nature imputed to all

notes: Cap. VII quarto densify section 429 from locked 1661 Latin (p. 296).
